plan.title: Recreate Closed RFQ with 15-Minute End Time

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ summary for the buyer-side recreate flow.
Enable the required eRFX project setting for the case.
Open the Recreate Order pop-up from the event's stage settings.
Confirm the recreate dialog includes the Product Sheet section.
Confirm the recreate dialog includes Auction Configurations.
Confirm the recreate dialog includes Delivery Date.
Confirm the recreate dialog exposes the scheduling choice.
Verify that the requested 15-minute event-end duration is offered.
Confirm the evaluation duration remains 30 minutes.
Confirm no schedule is selected, so the recreated event should start immediately.
Create the recreated event with the selected settings.
Confirm creation navigated to the new event page.
Confirm the newly created event is live immediately.
Confirm the new live event displays its bidding end-time field.
Confirm the recreated event shows the prepared RFQ's quantity.
Confirm the recreated event shows the prepared RFQ's unit.
